parameters.name: EffectiveAuthenticationSourceIds
parameters.description: The list of effective authentication source IDs.

parameters.name: PasswordExpirationAction
parameters.description:
The action to take when a password expires. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationStatus is set to enabled. Valid values:
- forbid\_login: Prohibit logon.
- force\_update\_password: Force password change.
- remind\_update\_password: Remind to change password.

parameters.name: PasswordExpirationNotificationChannels
parameters.description: The list of password expiration notification channels. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus is set to enabled.

parameters.name: PasswordExpirationNotificationDuration
parameters.description: The password expiration notification time, in days. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus is set to enabled.

parameters.name: PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus
parameters.description:
The password expiration notification status. Valid values:
- enabled: Enabled.
- disabled: Disabled.

parameters.name: PasswordExpirationStatus
parameters.description:
The password expiration configuration status. Valid values:
- enabled: Enabled.
- disabled: Disabled.

parameters.name: PasswordForcedUpdateDuration
parameters.description: The forced password change time, in days. The value of this parameter must be greater than the value of PasswordExpirationNotificationDuration.

parameters.name: PasswordValidMaxDay
parameters.description: The validity period of a password, in days. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationStatus is set to enabled.
